## 🔧 Key Configurations

### Nginx Reverse Proxy

**Purpose**: Route HTTP/HTTPS traffic to Spring Boot backend

**Configuration**: `/etc/nginx/conf.d/memorylab.conf`

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name mlab.snowytiger.me;

    # SSL certificates (Let's Encrypt)
    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/mlab.snowytiger.me/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/mlab.snowytiger.me/privkey.pem;

    # Proxy to Spring Boot on localhost:8080
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # Serve React frontend static files
    location / {
        root /srv/memorylab/frontend;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }
}
```

**Status**: ✅ Configuration test passed

### Systemd Service

**File**: `/etc/systemd/system/memorylab.service`

```ini
[Unit]
Description=MemoryLab Spring Boot

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -Duser.timezone=Asia/Seoul \

[Install]
```
